page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, with the page number 81 at the top left. No margin notes. Bottom left: signature "c 5" and a printer's mark "*". Bottom right: catchword "ciffe,".

main_text.p: praeferendam fatetur, praef. in N. T. anni 1559. ubi Erasmum reprehendit, eò quòd veterem interpretem rejicit, quia à Græcis dissentiebat, cūm emendatius exemplar secutus esse videatur. Videatur idem in Luc. 2.33. Mar. 3.5. & 14.36. & alibi. Doctissimè[?] P. Fagius in Chald. Paraph. Gen. 4. de iis qui ubi vulgatā non ad literam per omnia Textui Hebræo respondere vident, illa exibilant, damnant, &c. ita loquitur: Non attendunt, quid vel quem secutus fuerit Vulgatus author; cūm enim à veritate Heb. differre videtur, vel Sept. vel Paraph. Chald. vel aliquem ex Rabbinis sequutum fuisse fere semper deprehendo. Non est ergo temerè nata Vulgata editio, ut quidam scioli stultè et impudenter clamitant. Lud. de Dieu praef. Animadv. in 4. Evang. authorem Vulgatæ doctissimum esse judicat, ejúsque fidem et judicium admiratur. If.[?] Casaubonus differentias Vulgatæ à Græco non semper in Vulgatæ depravationem vel Interpretis errorem referunt; sed in Græcos codices quibus usus est interpres Latinus, à quibus variant hodierni, quòque sæpè hodiernis præfert. Vide Matth. 11. 21, 22. & 15. 39. & 21. 7. Joh. 12. 40. & 18. 1. Act. 3. 24. & 12. 8. &c. Et quidem de MS. nostro Alexandr. observatum est, quòd ubi à Vaticano Codice differt, sæpissimè cum Vulgata Latina congruat. Agmen claudat doctiss. H. Grotius praef. in annot. in Bibl. qui fatetur se Vulgatum Latinum interpretem semper plurimi fe- ciffe,

page.notes: The printer's mark "*" beside the signature "c 5" at the foot is not text and is left out. The word after "fe-" is the catchword "ciffe,". Doubtful readings: "Doctissimè" (the final letter is a superscript mark, read as è), "If." (the abbreviation is read from a small form). The Greek-letter title of Casaubon is printed in roman, not Greek, and is copied as "Casaubonus". Printing and spelling are kept as printed.
